task.title: To log in to X-Author Contracts
task.shortdesc: After logging in, the X-Author pane refreshes to display a list of agreement documents.

step.cmd: Launch Microsoft Word. Open a new document or the document you want to work with.
Launch the X-Author add-in as described in Installing X-Author Contracts.

After the X-Author add-in pane loads, click the menu icon on the left-hand side to display the Manage Connections option, if you are logging in for the first time. If it is your subsequent login, select the connection name from the left-hand menu to log in.
In the Manage Connections screen, enter:

substep.cmd: Complete this action.Connection Name: Enter the connection name for your connection.

Complete this action.Host Name: Enter the host URL for your instance of Apttus CLM and click Save. For Salesforce environments, use either https://login-sfdc.apttuscloud.com (production) or https://test-sfdc.apttuscloud.com (sandbox). This redirects you to the Sign-in page.

step.cmd: If it is the first time you are logging into CLM from the add-in, you may be prompted to allow access to X-Author. Click Allow to proceed.
Enter your host credentials (email and password) and click Sign In.

result.p: After logging in, the X-Author pane refreshes to display a list of agreement documents.
